reviewContext.scope: Phase 1c spec review gate (iteration 2, lean mode)
reviewContext.note:
Iter-1 finding closure judgment (verified by re-reading the requirements each finding cited, NOT by trusting addresses_findings frontmatter):

FIND-001 (critical, REQ-B4 dimensional bug): CLOSED. REQ-B4 line 213-227 now compares cumulative_token_cost_jpy (JPY) to 5 × cumulative_jpy_earned (JPY); dimensional coherence restored; 7-day grace via first_seen_ts prevents first-pass kill. PROP-B4-killswitch (verification-architecture.md line 72) tests grace + dimensional check.

FIND-002 (critical, REQ-B2 formula): CLOSED. REQ-B2 line 187-208 gives fully-parenthesized closed-form Σ over model_breakdown with FX applied to entire USD total; per-model rate table frozen 2026-07-01 (line 148-153); refuses to write on unknown model_id. PROP-B2-cost-formula has golden fixture (Sonnet 1M/1M @ FX=150 = 2700) AND unknown-model raise assertion (line 70).

FIND-003 (high, classify purity): CLOSED. HealthcheckContext record (line 75-78) carries all inputs; classify(ctx) is genuinely pure per verification-architecture.md line 24.

FIND-004 (critical, REQ-A5 RCE): CLOSED. REQ-A5 line 118-127 requires strict npm-name regex AND allowlist file (`hook-modules-allowlist.txt`); failure path escalates instead of installing. PROP-A-hook-allowlist promoted to required:true (line 68).

FIND-005 (high, OAuth phishing): CLOSED. REQ-A3 line 111 specifies anchored regex `^https://claude\.com/cai/oauth/authorize\?[a-z0-9_=&%+\.\-]+$`; PROP-A-oauth required:true (line 67) with 30-fixture corpus including phishing variants.

FIND-006 (high, escalate.sh under-spec): CLOSED. REQ-F1 line 357-382 has 7-step contract: dedup-check → log-pending → printf '%q' shell-escape → gh create → tg post (env-var TG_BOT_API, 3-retry exp-backoff) → log-update-posted. PROP-F1-order (line 85) verifies the ordering as integration test.

FIND-007 (critical, PROP-F2 evidence_hash): CLOSED. REQ-F1 step 1 (line 359-362) defines dedup_key = sha256(slot || \x00 || reason || \x00 || normalize_evidence(evidence)); normalize_evidence strips `\b\d{10}\b` (unix ts), `\bround-\d+\b`, `\bts:\d+\b`. PROP-F2 (line 86) is property-test over 100-pair corpus that must collapse.

FIND-008 (high, first-pass grace): CLOSED. STALE_FIRST_PASS mode added at priority 9 (line 95) keyed on last_start_mtime; EDGE-8 (line 475-477) describes the mid-flight semantics; PROP-A-classify covers all 10 modes.

FIND-009 (high, priority order): CLOSED. NOT_LOGGED_IN at priority 3 now outranks STALE at priority 8 (line 84-95); spec explicitly states the FIND-009 reason in line 88; BACKOFF at priority 1 is correctly terminal.

FIND-010 (high, verification tier mismatch): CLOSED. PROPs touching orchestration (PROP-E1, E2, E3, E4, F1, C3, D2, G2-static, G2-runtime) explicitly tagged as integration with described mechanism (sandbox, stubbed external calls, fixture verdicts); annotation explained in verification-architecture.md line 103-104.

FIND-011 (high, EDGE-6 token estimation): CLOSED. REQ-B6 line 239-251 adds token_source field, 2× cost penalty for estimated rows (conservative direction), and >50%-estimated escalation; PROP-B6-estimate (line 74) verifies exactly-2× penalty.

FIND-012 (medium, E1 scheduling): CLOSED. REQ-E1 line 322-332 specifies launchd plist `ai.anicca.<slot>-adversary-daily.plist` with StartCalendarInterval, claude -p wrapper, explicit two-level fresh-context spawn. (See ROUND-2-002 for a NEW concern about spawn-surface immutability.)

FIND-013 (medium, D2 dedup race): CLOSED. REQ-D2 line 297-310 implements claim-check: tentative row written FIRST, then gh, then status update; gh failure leaves row pending with 24h cooldown. EDGE-9 documents disk-full case.

FIND-014 (medium, required set): CLOSED. Required set expanded from 5 to 10 PROPs (verification-architecture.md line 107-124); PROP-A-hook-allowlist, PROP-A-oauth, PROP-C1-evidence, PROP-G2-static, PROP-G2-runtime added; PROPs are non-overlapping (each targets a distinct invariant: classify mutex / anti-phishing / anti-RCE / cost formula / kill-switch / evidence faithfulness / strategy gate / dedup / static manifest-write / runtime earn verification).

FIND-015 (medium, G2 event schema): CLOSED at the schema level. REQ-G2(b) line 408-417 declares full event row schema {event, slot, pass_id, ts, receipt_id?, amount_jpy?, amount_usdc?, platform?, platform_api_call:{endpoint, request_sha256, response_sha256}, raw_response_path?} and a runtime verification step. HOWEVER the verification mechanism has a hash-replay loophole — see ROUND-2-001, which is the same INV-13 active-half gap re-emerging in a new disguise.

Closure totals: 15 of 15 iter-1 findings CLOSED. NEW findings: 2 (ROUND-2-001 critical, ROUND-2-002 high) — both surfaced by the iter-2 expanded surface (REQ-G2 runtime verification mechanism and REQ-E1 two-level fresh-context spawn) and neither is a duplicate of an iter-1 finding.

REQ-B2 closed-form cost formula with per-model table — FIND-002 verified closed
REQ-A5 npm allowlist + escalation default — FIND-004 verified closed
REQ-F1 full 7-step contract with shell-escape + TG endpoint — FIND-006 verified closed
REQ-F1 dedup_key + normalize_evidence — FIND-007 verified closed
REQ-G2(b) runtime verification — schema closed but introduces hash-replay loophole (ROUND-2-001)
classify(HealthcheckContext) typed input — FIND-003 verified closed
Proof table re-tiered; integration PROPs explicitly tagged — FIND-010 verified closed
Required set expanded from 5 to 10 PROPs with non-overlapping invariants — FIND-014 verified closed
REQ-E1 two-level fresh-context — but spawn-surface immutability is NOT guarded (ROUND-2-002)
